plain: A man named Jordan, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2024 he got in touch with a journalist named Ross Coulthart. He says he flew to Washington, DC, and met Coulthart there to tell his story. He tells it to explain how his account first reached people looking into government UFO secrets.
